# Penpoint

> A desktop app where writers write their manuscript and organize their worldbuilding in one place. Manuscript editor, visual relationship maps, story arc visualizers, instant search, and chapter scanning. $40 one-time purchase, no subscription. Windows, macOS, Linux.

Penpoint combines a distraction-free manuscript editor with visual worldbuilding tools. Writers no longer need to juggle Word for drafting and spreadsheets for tracking. Write your entire novel and organize your characters, locations, items, and plot arcs in one app. All data stays on your computer.
